name: Swift Block Super 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev) - Umbreon, Pokémon Series
description: The Swift Block Super 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev) - Umbreon, Pokémon Series pairs a genuine Pokémon collaboration with a dual magnetic ring MagLev core, giving you a flagship-feel speed cube built around a nighttime Umbreon theme. Between the springless MagLev feel, 8-level GES tuning, and a dedicated Umbreon center cap, this is a cube that looks the part and turns like it means it.
features: MagLev turning: Repelling magnets replace the springs for a smooth, consistent feel with no spring noise and no fatigue over long sessions.
Dial in your feel: The 8-level GES elasticity system lets you refresh the turning feel by hand, so the cube grows with you instead of getting left behind.
Theme runs deep: Beyond the center cap, the magnetic capsules and color pieces carry the nighttime Umbreon palette through the whole cube.
8-level GES elasticity: Adjust spring tension by hand across eight settings to shift between a looser, faster feel and a tighter, more controlled one.
MagLev core: The springless magnetic-levitation core delivers a steady, quiet return without traditional spring resistance.
Dual magnetic ring layout: A 76-point magnetic system with an omnidirectional core adds positioning strength and helps the cube settle into place.
